svg.text: The system is at stage 1 today and is already running online (see chapter 7 of the technical design document). Stage 2 requires no rewrite: the catalogue, the roster and the business

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: rules are all configuration, and connecting a real channel means swapping a provider implementation.

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: The timing and scope of stages 2 and 3 are planning assumptions and have not been carried out
